model.name: AnimateAnyMesh Text to Mesh Animation
model.description: AnimateAnyMesh (HUST / Alibaba DAMO, ICCV 2025) animates a static 3D mesh from a text description of its motion: 16 frames of vertex trajectories, no rig, returned as a morph-animated GLB that keeps the mesh textures.
